user.title: Set up Sendspin
user.description: Home Assistant will act as a Sendspin server so it can adopt and route Sendspin speakers on your network. It does not play audio itself and does not advertise itself over mDNS.

data_description.name: The name speakers see when Home Assistant connects to them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single Sendspin configuration is allowed.
